body:
Bounded correction follow-up from #490. This issue owns exactly the nine physical-fragment rows listed below and the source-role/selection rationale for those rows. Parent evidence: `data/regional-review/regional-review-2d6fa291e9384c2f/`.

The current metadata marks these `atlas:physical` IDs as `source_role=Province` with an administrative-unit selection rationale. Their source chains pair predecessor provinces Cordillera (`80513517B19404624083023`) or Velasco (`80513517B10383084964738`) with RESOLVE 2017 ecoregion ECO_IDs 476, 504, 523, 529, 567, 569, 584. RESOLVE describes ecological/natural boundaries. The #490 overlay supports derivation of the portions but does not make them administrative units. Review the role, selection rationale and whether this identity/tier belongs in the published location collection. Preserve IDs, footprints, source bytes and predecessor claims pending engineering integration. Do not mutate shared hierarchy or geometry.

All exact affected location IDs:
- `atlas:physical:13555fd3cb230149ca55`

Include canonical references, dates, licenses, retained-byte hashes or lawful restoration steps. Check both predecessor source polygons and all seven mapped ecoregion features; do not infer administrative ownership from physical ecology. This child depends on #490's evidence and does not approve the broader region or enable historical imports.

Owned path: `data/regional-review/regional-supplement-bolivia-ecoregion-roles-2026/`.
